title: Conflict Resolution
definition: Conflict resolution is the biblical pursuit of addressing disagreement, offense, and division with truth, humility, repentance, forgiveness, and love.
summary: Conflict should not be handled through gossip, bitterness, revenge, or avoidance. Scripture calls believers to seek peace in ways that honor Christ.
christFocus: Christ reconciles sinners to God and gives His people a pattern for humble, truthful, and gracious reconciliation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Conflict should not be handled through gossip, bitterness, revenge, or avoidance. Scripture calls believers to seek peace in ways that honor Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
